'''Ryōtarō Okiayu''' (Japanese: '''置鮎 龍太郎''' ''Okiayu Ryōtarō'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Okiayu was born on November 17, 1969 in {{wp|Kitakyushu}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became an actor as an adult. He originally voiced a character-of-the-day in {{aniseries|PTS}} before returning to the franchise in over two decades later in ''[[New Pokémon Snap]]'' and later {{aniseries|HZ}}.
